overview: TradeNest Naturals supplies Arjun Bark Powder from Terminalia arjuna stem bark for B2B buyers who need a consistent botanical ingredient. We are an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter in India. Each batch is processed through sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, packing, and dispatch.

Our Arjun Bark Powder is fine milled to 80-100 mesh and packed for bulk trade, OEM, and private label requirements. Custom mesh and packaging can be arranged on request. We support export documentation and can provide samples on request. The product is stored and handled for commercial supply needs, with a shelf life of 24 months when kept in a cool, dry place away from sunlight and moisture.
highlights: Custom mesh and packaging on request
